Words > Export for Anki. The deck file (.apkg) is the easy way: double-click it and Anki adds a Polyglotic deck with its own note type - word, reading, meaning, the sentence with the word in bold, its translation - and Anki's own text-to-speech for sound. The CSV imports as it is into Anki's Basic (front and back), whatever Anki's language. For a note type of your own, pick it in Anki's import dialog and match its fields to the columns by number: 1 word, 4 reading, 5 meaning, 6 sentence, 7 translation. Keep to one of the two: a word stays the kind of note it first came as. Exporting again updates the same cards rather than doubling them, and leaves your own notes and tags on words that haven't changed here; tick Only words not exported yet to keep the file short. Anki may call 行 (háng) and 行 (xíng) duplicates - it compares the first field only. They are two words: keep both.
